exam.title: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
exam.study_prerequisites: Practical security operations across Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview and Defender for Cloud, plus KQL, Windows/Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, incident response, threat hunting, automation, and current AI-agent/Copilot concepts.

review.notes: Every subobjective in the July 28, 2026 blueprint is mapped to a configuration boundary, operating decision, query/investigation path, evidence artifact, failure action, or recovery proof. Three integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 36 original checks cover Defender XDR notifications/tuning, Endpoint settings/ASR/device groups/custom data collection, AIR and attack disruption, Sentinel automation, roles, data tiers/retention, workbooks and SOC optimization, Windows/AMA/DCR/WEF/Syslog/CEF/Azure/threat-intelligence/custom-table ingestion, Defender and Sentinel detection engineering, cross-domain incident response, Endpoint actions, Purview/Audit/eDiscovery/Graph evidence, KQL and Advanced Hunting, threat analytics, Sentinel Graph, data-lake jobs/summaries/notebooks/MCP, Security Copilot and agentic investigation. All 48 cited URLs are exact catalog entries: 46 were reachable and the O'Reilly and Udemy pages were access-blocked; none was missing or broken. The guide marks older secondary sources as foundations, verifies the active exam, free Practice Assessment and 43 hours 12 minutes of current Learn paths, calls out the March 31, 2027 Sentinel Azure-portal support end, and records no announced blueprint change or retirement.

findings.title: September onboarding requires tenant-cohort distinction
findings.evidence: New customers use integrated Sentinel onboarding and Fabric paths; existing lake customers retain prior workflows.
findings.recommendation: Add cohort-aware retention, notebooks, scenario and lab decisions.
findings.resolution: Add cohort-aware retention, notebooks, scenario and lab decisions.

findings.title: New mirror does not recover historical telemetry
findings.evidence: Preview mirrors expose new data only and use connection identity plus Fabric access.
findings.recommendation: Add no-backfill, capacity and consumer-authorization checks.
findings.resolution: Add no-backfill, capacity and consumer-authorization checks.

findings.title: Custom collection has rolling device/rule budget
findings.evidence: One selected workspace, dynamic tags and 75000 events per device/rule/rolling 24h require planning.
findings.recommendation: Add collection-budget example, source scope and deployment validation.
findings.resolution: Add collection-budget example, source scope and deployment validation.

findings.title: AccountName no longer reliably contains full UPN
findings.evidence: July mapping standardizes prefix with separate suffix/full UPN fields.
findings.recommendation: Add migration and identity-specific automation example with substring counterexamples.
findings.resolution: Add migration and identity-specific automation example with substring counterexamples.

findings.title: Aggregation must preserve event and analyst scope
findings.evidence: Current guidance recommends event identifiers and requires SentinelScope_CF for scoped alert visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add same-event tuple example, permission/lookback/volume and scope guidance.
findings.resolution: Add same-event tuple example, permission/lookback/volume and scope guidance.

findings.title: NRT does not erase ingestion latency
findings.evidence: Sentinel uses ingestion-time windows, two-minute built-in delay and one-minute cadence; multiple tables differ from Defender Continuous.
findings.recommendation: Add two-clock example and separate limits.
findings.resolution: Add two-clock example and separate limits.

findings.title: TI republishing is not new threat observation
findings.evidence: Legacy ingestion stopped; updated objects republish every 7–10 days and include deletion/version semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add latest-before-filter logic and historical/schema preservation limits.
findings.resolution: Add latest-before-filter logic and historical/schema preservation limits.

findings.title: Connected badge is weaker than operational freshness
findings.evidence: Diagnostic connector status can reflect any ingestion within 14 days; policy assignment differs from resource remediation and data arrival.
findings.recommendation: Add subscription/resource distinction and source-inventory freshness test.
findings.resolution: Add subscription/resource distinction and source-inventory freshness test.

findings.title: Endpoint response depends on platform/session limits
findings.evidence: Command roles, OS support, session concurrency and transfer/time limits differ.
findings.recommendation: Add evidence-first session planning and command-log checks.
findings.resolution: Add evidence-first session planning and command-log checks.

findings.title: Graph request status does not prove content exfiltration
findings.evidence: RequestId and batch OperationId differ; logs expose request metadata and potentially sensitive URIs.
findings.recommendation: Add request-level correlation and evidence boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add request-level correlation and evidence boundaries.

findings.title: Signin result code is string typed
findings.evidence: SigninLogs ResultType uses string zero for success.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit string comparison and qualify nonzero failures and capped IP sets.
findings.resolution: Use explicit string comparison and qualify nonzero failures and capped IP sets.

findings.title: MCP prerequisites differ by collection and tool
findings.evidence: Triage accepts Defender/Endpoint/Sentinel and file tools differ in hash support.
findings.recommendation: Add discover-schema-query sequence and tool-specific authorization/input checks.
findings.resolution: Add discover-schema-query sequence and tool-specific authorization/input checks.

findings.title: Official Sentinel Continuous eligibility conflicts
findings.evidence: Custom-detection table list includes Sentinel; unified-hunting known issues say Sentinel NRT is unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Official lake-tier hunting statements require reconciliation
findings.evidence: Table settings warn of losing Advanced Hunting; September release/hunting pages describe access with cohort and retention restrictions.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.
